topics.title: The evening light on the houses

concepts.learning_objective: Interpret the image of 'light, chill and yellow' bathing the 'serene foreheads of houses'.
Identify personification in the opening lines and explain its effect.

topics.title: The thrush's song and the coming of spring

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the thrush's song announces spring and relates to the title 'Coming'.
Analyse the phrase 'fresh-peeled voice' and the idea of the song 'astonishing the brickwork'.

topics.title: The speaker's childhood and the child at adult reconciling

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the speaker calls his childhood 'a forgotten boredom'.
Analyse the comparison between the speaker's joy at spring and a child who sees adults reconciling.
Recall facts about Philip Larkin, the Movement and the volume from which the poem is taken.
Evaluate the poem's quiet, hopeful tone and its short free-verse lines.
State the main features of the haiku as a Japanese three-line poem.
Interpret the images and ideas in the haiku 'Cobra', 'Night' and 'Alone'.
